name: Shattering Edge
description: Cut with an edge that shatters on contact so the strike lands and the guard is thrown wide.

name: Shattering Plate
description: Hold a plate that breaks apart under force and builds itself again whole in the same breath.

name: Shattering Lens
description: Look through a cracked lens of crystal and see every line along which a thing would break.

name: Shattering Purge
description: Break a binding or a curse on an ally along its weakest seam and let the pieces fall away.

name: Shattering Crash
description: Smash a great block of crystal onto the target so the guard and the body behind it break apart.

name: Lattice Ruin
description: Break the lattice standing through the field so that its edges fly outward and cut every foe within.

name: Shattering Pierce
description: Drive one splintered crystal lance through guard and armour into the body of the foe.

name: Shattering Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of tough crystal over the nearby allies that rebuilds itself as each blow breaks it.

name: Shattering Cage
description: Close a great cage of crystal round the foes and break its bars inward so they are held and cut.

name: Shattering Light
description: Break a great crystal and loose the light stored in it in a single beam that pierces a whole rank of foes.

name: Shattering Return
description: Take a mighty blow on the crystal and break it outward so the force flies back at the one who struck.

name: Shattering Crown
description: Raise a crown of crystal over the field and break it so shards pierce the foes with a force scaling to the reserve.

name: Glass Cataclysm
description: Break a lattice set through the whole field and cut all within down to the destructive ceiling of a crystal master of this tier.
